sentences.text: It is an amphibian with a length of 11 cm and a mass of 48 g; its status is LC (least concern).
In Mainz-Bingen, 71 reports were recorded in ten years, with the main time Feb–Apr.
Its habitat includes land, water, and trees, and it is active by day and at night.
It has been recorded as prey for the Barred grass snake, Grey heron, European herring gull, and Red fox.
